content.short: DuckChain is a Layer 2 solution for TON focused on enhancing the scalability for gaming and social dApps.
content.description: DuckChain is a specialized Layer 2 scaling solution designed specifically to augment the capabilities of the TON blockchain, with a particular focus on the gaming and social dApp segments. It aims to provide even higher transaction speeds and lower costs, enabling developers to build more complex and highly interactive applications without being constrained by the mainnet's throughput. DuckChain fosters a vibrant sub-ecosystem of 'Duck' themed projects and social games, contributing to the overall diversity and scalability of the broader TON network.
content.meta: Explore the next level of scalability with DuckChain, the TON-focused Layer 2. Learn more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
